concepts.title: Key Concepts
concepts.ia: Investment Attractiveness (IA): A score 0-100 showing how attractive an asset is for investment.
concepts.gate: Quality Gate: Strict checks an asset must pass. If it fails, it's automatically rejected.
concepts.decision: Decision: The system's final verdict — Buy, Watch, Investigate, Avoid, or Reject.
concepts.pq: Project Quality (PQ): Evaluation of team, technology, and market position.
concepts.tq: Token Quality (TQ): Evaluation of tokenomics, utility, and distribution.
concepts.va: Value Accrual (VA): Whether protocol revenue actually reaches tokenholders.
concepts.v: Valuation (V): Is the current token price fair, overvalued, or undervalued.
concepts.r: Risk (R): Aggregate of technical, financial, regulatory, and market risks.
